prompt:
电商评价与口碑图。核心任务：通过真实用户反馈建立社会证明。受众：{由用户输入，或根据商品与用户资料总结}。主题：{由用户输入，或根据商品资料总结}。文案：{只使用用户提供的核对过的文案}。评价内容：{仅使用用户提供的真实评价、平台资料或明确可用的口碑信息，不得虚构用户名、评分、销量或评价}。口碑关键词：{从真实评价中提炼}。其余评价呈现形式与视觉表达请自主完成。场景和周边元素可以采用指定画风，但是必须保持商品的写实风格。

本次输入：【填写商品外观、图的用途、已核对的规格与可展示文案】。
有事实、名称、数字或引文时，按输入使用；信息缺失的模块留空或省略。
promptEnglish:
E-commerce review and word-of-mouth image. Core task: Establish social proof through authentic customer feedback. Audience: {Input by user, or summarized based on product and user data}. Theme: {Input by user, or summarized based on product data}. Copy: {Use only approved copy supplied by the user}. Review content: {Use only genuine user reviews, platform data, or verified reputation data; do not fabricate usernames, ratings, sales counts, or reviews}. Reputation keywords: {Extracted from authentic reviews}. Autonomously determine review presentation formats and visual styling. Background scenes and surrounding elements may adopt the specified artistic style, but the product itself must strictly maintain a realistic photographic style.

Inputs: [Provide product appearance, purpose of the image, verified specifications, and approved copy].
Use supplied facts, names, numbers and quotations. Leave sections without data blank or omit them.
